style_prefix: Premium preschool mobile game art, original 2D cartoon illustration for children aged 3-5. Soft, rounded, chubby shapes; clean deep-plum (#5B4565) outlines of even medium weight; gentle cel shading lit from the upper left with lavender-tinted shadows (never gray or black); pastel candy palette: pastel pink #FFC8DD, lavender #CDB4DB, mint #B9F3D9, light turquoise #A0E7E5, baby blue #BDE0FE, peach #FFD6BA, cream #FFF6E5, soft yellow #FFF1A8. Warm, cheerful storybook look. Crisp, high resolution, no blur. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.

puppy_reference.prompt: Character design reference sheet image of ONE adorable original baby puppy character named Biscuit. Full body, front view, sitting upright, perfectly symmetrical, facing the viewer. Big round head (about 55% of total height) with two long soft floppy ears hanging down on each side of the head, ears are peach (#FFD6BA) with pink inner tone. Single character centered with empty space around it, isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground shadow.

Keep the top 10% calm for UI buttons. Soft warm morning light. No characters, no animals, no bathtub, no text.
